items.q: What if I don't know my exact time of birth?
items.a: We'll cast the chart for noon. The positions of the Sun, planets and most aspects stay accurate, but we can't calculate houses and the Ascendant — those sections are skipped. The time is often on your birth certificate or hospital records.

items.q: How is this different from a horoscope?
items.a: A horoscope describes one twelfth of humanity by Sun sign. A birth chart is the position of ten planets, the Ascendant and houses at the moment you were born, and the angles between them. Two people with the same sign get two different texts from us.

The calculation is done by software using the Swiss Ephemeris. The text is composed by a language model following a method written by Chronika's astrologers; every paragraph is tied to a specific position or aspect in your chart.

items.q: How do you store my data?
items.a: Your date, time and place of birth are stored only to build your documents and are deleted after 30 days. We don't share them with third parties.

pages.title: Venus in Gemini, 11th house
body: In love you need conversation. Not compliments — a conversation that is actually interesting. A relationship with nothing to talk about ends for you before your partner notices.
The eleventh house makes friends and partners neighbouring categories: many of your relationships started as friendships, and that is a method, not an accident.

pages.title: Moon square Mars
body: The fastest reaction in your chart. When something important is touched, the body answers before the thought does. That gives you courage — and a few words you later regret.
What to do with it: redirect rather than suppress. Physical action in the first minutes takes the initial impulse and leaves clarity.

pages.title: Money: Taurus and the second house
body: You treat money like food: what matters is not the amount but the feeling that there is a reserve. An empty account worries you more than it should, a full one soothes more than it should.
Saturn in the eighth house adds caution around shared money and credit.
